subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
skillName: Magnetic and Electric Forces Without Touching

items.prompt: Can magnets push or pull without touching?

steps: Magnetic forces act across a gap without contact.

items.prompt: When two magnets push apart, do they attract or repel?
When two magnets pull together, do they attract or repel?
Does a magnet pull a paper clip harder when closer or farther?

steps: The magnetic force is stronger when the objects are closer.

items.prompt: A balloon rubbed on hair picks up paper bits. What force causes this?

steps: Static electricity creates a force that attracts the paper.

items.prompt: Name one force that works without objects touching.
items.answer: A magnetic force (or static electric force)

steps: Magnetic and static electric forces act across a gap.

items.prompt: Does a magnet pick up a plastic button?

steps: Magnets attract certain metals, not plastic.

items.prompt: Does a magnet pick up a steel nail?

steps: Magnets attract steel and some other metals.

items.prompt: As two magnets move apart, does the force get stronger or weaker?

steps: The force weakens with more distance.

items.prompt: Write a cause-and-effect question about magnets and distance.
items.answer: Does a magnet pull harder when it is closer to an object?

steps: This asks how distance (cause) affects the pull (effect).

items.prompt: Explain why a balloon can attract paper without touching it.
items.answer: The balloon has static electricity that pulls the paper across a gap

steps: The charged balloon exerts a force on the paper without contact.

items.prompt: How could you test whether distance changes a magnet's pull?
items.answer: Hold the magnet at different distances from a clip and see when it is pulled

steps: Changing only the distance shows its effect on the pull.

items.prompt: Two magnets repel. What happens if you flip one around?

steps: Flipping a magnet changes repelling into attracting.

items.prompt: Why is the type of material a cause of whether a magnet pulls an object?
items.answer: Magnets attract some metals but not materials like plastic

steps: The material determines whether the magnet attracts it.

items.prompt: Describe an investigation to find what causes a magnet to pull some objects but not others.
items.answer: Test the magnet on many objects of different materials and record which it pulls

steps: Comparing materials shows the material is the cause of the difference.
